name: nonApi_logBetaCase
description: The cloud Beta Testers assistant's memory (E18.F9.S3, 2026-10-14): one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'beta-room') saying a tester's case was CLOSED up to a room sequence (the proposal was emailed to James), or that messages up to a sequence were SEEN and needed no reply. The room's messages are the case; this only marks where each tester's case ends. Called by the API (BetaRoomAssistant) only. Idempotency: log-only — a repeated row says the same thing; readers take the MAX sequence per tester.

parameters.name: reporterPublicId
parameters.description: The tester's PUBLIC hasher id (the room's author id), stored lowercase.

parameters.name: lastSequence
parameters.description: The room MessageSequenceCount the case ends at; stored as 'seq=<n>' at the start of Data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Optional summary (the proposal title), trimmed to fit 4000 characters with the seq prefix.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
